info.title: Epic FHIR
info.description: Read patient demographics, clinical notes, document content, encounters, and insurance coverage from Epic through FHIR R4. Includes an MCP endpoint for Copilot Studio agents and typed actions for Power Automate and Power Apps.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for Copilot Studio. Exposes read-only patient, clinical note, encounter, and coverage tools against Epic FHIR R4.

get.description: Searches for patients by demographics or identifier (Epic Patient.Search (Demographics)). By default Epic requires one of: an identifier (FHIR ID or MRN); given name + family name + birth date; or given name + family name + legal sex + phone or email. Review every match before you act on a result.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Patient's family (last) name.

parameters.name: given
parameters.description: Patient's given name. First and middle names are supported.

parameters.name: birthdate
parameters.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Patient identifier as <system>|<value> or <value>, such as an MRN.

parameters.name: legal-sex
parameters.description: Legal sex: male, female, other, or unknown. Takes precedence over Gender.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Administrative gender: male, female, other, or unknown.

parameters.name: telecom
parameters.description: Phone number or email address.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Any part of the patient's name. Ignored when Family Name or Given Name is provided.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Street address.

parameters.name: address-city
parameters.description: City of the home address.

parameters.name: address-state
parameters.description: State of the home address.

parameters.name: address-postalcode
parameters.description: Postal code of the home address.

parameters.name: _id
parameters.description: Patient FHIR ID. When provided, other search parameters are ignored.

parameters.name: _count
parameters.description: Maximum results per page.

400.description: Bad request. The body is an OperationOutcome.

401.description: The access token is missing, expired, or invalid.

403.description: The user or app is not authorized for this resource.

get.description: Retrieves a patient's demographics by FHIR ID (Epic Patient.Read (Demographics)).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Patient FHIR ID.

400.description: Bad request. The body is an OperationOutcome.

401.description: The access token is missing, expired, or invalid.

403.description: The user or app is not authorized for this resource.

get.description: Searches a patient's document references, such as clinical notes (Epic DocumentReference.Search (Clinical Notes)). Each result's content lists Binary IDs that you pass to Get binary content to read the note text.

parameters.name: patient
parameters.description: Patient FHIR ID.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Document category. Use clinical-note for clinical notes.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Note type as <system>|<code>, such as http://loinc.org|11506-3 for progress notes.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Earliest note creation date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 date-time). Sent to Epic as date=ge{value}.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Latest note creation date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 date-time). Sent to Epic as date=le{value}.

parameters.name: docstatus
parameters.description: Note status.

parameters.name: encounter
parameters.description: Encounter FHIR ID for the encounter associated with the note.

parameters.name: _count
parameters.description: Maximum results per page.

400.description: Bad request. The body is an OperationOutcome.

401.description: The access token is missing, expired, or invalid.

403.description: The user or app is not authorized for this resource.

get.description: Retrieves a document reference, such as a clinical note's metadata, by FHIR ID (Epic DocumentReference.Read (Clinical Notes)).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: DocumentReference FHIR ID.

400.description: Bad request. The body is an OperationOutcome.

401.description: The access token is missing, expired, or invalid.

403.description: The user or app is not authorized for this resource.

get.description: Retrieves document content, such as the HTML or RTF text of a clinical note, by Binary FHIR ID (Epic Binary.Read). Content is returned Base64-encoded in Data.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Binary FHIR ID, taken from a document reference's content attachment URL (Binary/{id}).

parameters.name: includeDecodedText
parameters.description: When Yes, also returns the content decoded as UTF-8 text in Decoded Text for textual content types. This parameter is handled by the connector and is not sent to Epic.

400.description: Bad request. The body is an OperationOutcome.

401.description: The access token is missing, expired, or invalid.

403.description: The user or app is not authorized for this resource.

get.description: Searches a patient's encounters (Epic Encounter.Search (Patient Chart)). Returns inpatient encounters and outpatient encounters that have been checked in. Future appointments are not returned.

parameters.name: patient
parameters.description: Patient FHIR ID.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Earliest encounter date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 date-time). Sent to Epic as date=ge{value}.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Latest encounter date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 date-time). Sent to Epic as date=le{value}.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Encounter status, such as finished or in-progress.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Encounter class as <system>|<code>. Your Epic organization defines the codes.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Encounter type, such as contact type or visit type.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Encounter identifier as <system>|<value>, such as a CSN.

parameters.name: _count
parameters.description: Maximum results per page.

400.description: Bad request. The body is an OperationOutcome.

401.description: The access token is missing, expired, or invalid.

403.description: The user or app is not authorized for this resource.

get.description: Retrieves an encounter by FHIR ID (Epic Encounter.Read (Patient Chart)).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Encounter FHIR ID.

400.description: Bad request. The body is an OperationOutcome.

401.description: The access token is missing, expired, or invalid.

403.description: The user or app is not authorized for this resource.

get.description: Searches a patient's insurance coverages (Epic Coverage.Search (Patient Insurance Information)). Returns every coverage that could apply to the patient, not only the coverages billed for a specific visit.

parameters.name: patient
parameters.description: Patient FHIR ID.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Coverage status, such as active.

parameters.name: _count
parameters.description: Maximum results per page.

400.description: Bad request. The body is an OperationOutcome.

401.description: The access token is missing, expired, or invalid.

403.description: The user or app is not authorized for this resource.
